(cl:in-package :cl-user)
(DEFUN COMPILER::P2-MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL (COMPILER::HIR) "Generate code for MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL that properly collects all values from all arguments.
   Uses block scope instead of IIFE to avoid potential scoping issues." (LET ((COMPILER::ARGS (COMPILER::HIR-ARG2 COMPILER::HIR))) (COND ((<= 1 (LENGTH COMPILER::ARGS)) (COMPILER::EMBED-SOURCE-MAP COMPILER::HIR) (DESTRUCTURING-BIND (COMPILER::FN-HIR . COMPILER::ARG-HIRS) COMPILER::ARGS (LET ((COMPILER::MV-ARRAY (COMPILER::P2-GENVAR "mvall")) (COMPILER::FN-VAR (COMPILER::P2-GENVAR "mvfn")) COMPILER::RESULT) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "{~%") (LET ((COMPILER::FN-REF (COMPILER::%P2-FORM COMPILER::FN-HIR))) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "let ~A=~A;~%" COMPILER::FN-VAR COMPILER::FN-REF)) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "let ~A=[];~%" COMPILER::MV-ARRAY) (DOLIST (COMPILER::ARG-HIR COMPILER::ARG-HIRS) (LET ((COMPILER::ARG-REF (COMPILER::P2-FORM COMPILER::ARG-HIR))) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "~A;~%" COMPILER::ARG-REF) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "~A.push(...lisp.currentValues());~%" COMPILER::MV-ARRAY))) (WHEN (COMPILER::HIR-RETURN-VALUE-P COMPILER::HIR) (SETQ COMPILER::RESULT (COMPILER::P2-TEMPORARY-VAR)) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "~A=~A(...~A);~%" COMPILER::RESULT COMPILER::FN-VAR COMPILER::MV-ARRAY)) (UNLESS (COMPILER::HIR-RETURN-VALUE-P COMPILER::HIR) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "~A(...~A);~%" COMPILER::FN-VAR COMPILER::MV-ARRAY)) (FORMAT COMPILER::*P2-EMIT-STREAM* "}~%") COMPILER::RESULT))) (T (COMPILER::P2-CALL-DEFAULT COMPILER::HIR)))))
